summary: Frontend-only testing of Google Identity Services (GIS) migration on /account. Confirmed GIS integration works: external script loaded from accounts.google.com/gsi/client, GIS button rendered inside [data-testid=account-google-gis], no Firebase popup/redirect used, no /__/auth/* URL contacted. Guest view renders correctly with all expected testids. Navbar account link navigates to /account. Clicking the rendered GIS button opens a Google OAuth popup to accounts.google.com (NOT Firebase /__/auth/*), and the main window origin remains unchanged — matches the bug fix contract.

test_results.account_guest_view: PASS - [data-testid=account-guest] rendered, 'Save your progress' card, 'No account is required to keep learning.' text present
test_results.gis_script_loaded: PASS - network request to https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client observed
test_results.gis_button_rendered: PASS - [data-testid=account-google-gis] has iframe content (697 chars), 'Continue with Google' visible
test_results.gis_unavailable_fallback: N/A - GIS loaded successfully; graceful fallback testid exists in code at Account.js:196
test_results.no_firebase_popup: PASS - No /__/auth/* network requests. Clicking GIS opens a Google OAuth popup at accounts.google.com/v3/signin (GIS flow), NOT Firebase popup. Main window origin unchanged.
test_results.no_crash: PASS - page remains fully functional, no React/console errors (only expected GSI_LOGGER warning about multiple initialize calls — benign)
test_results.content_regression: NOT_FULLY_VERIFIED - app gates content behind /onboarding for brand-new guests; automation could not auto-complete onboarding flow (no auto-advance via 'Empezar gratis'). This is pre-existing behavior unrelated to the GIS fix. Previous iterations confirm 50 situations and listening/speaking pages exist.

console_warnings: GSI_LOGGER: google.accounts.id.initialize() called multiple times - benign, caused by React StrictMode / re-renders; only last instance is used
action_items: (Low priority) Deduplicate GIS initialize() calls to silence 'initialize() is called multiple times' warning — possibly gate init in firebase.js so renderGisButton doesn't re-init on every render
critical_code_review_comments: Account.js correctly uses stateRef pattern for the shared GIS callback to avoid stale closure over isAuthenticated/confirmDelete.
No signInWithPopup/linkWithPopup/signInWithRedirect usage found in Account.js — migration is clean.
Graceful gisUnavailable handling present (sets state on load failure and when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is missing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GIS migration verified end-to-end at UI level. External GIS script reached Google from preview env, button renders, no Firebase popup/redirect. Content regression (situations/listening/speaking) is gated behind an onboarding flow that requires manual multi-step completion — if retesting, complete onboarding via UI selections before asserting situation cards. Account page itself does NOT require onboarding.
